subject: Pinnacle Health: elevated latency & error spike — Exec coordination

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: [Alert] Pinnacle - sustained p95 latency and 5xx spike

Priya / Laura —

Alert just escalated from monitoring: Pinnacle production region us-west-2 is showing p95 latency jumping from ~210ms to ~1.9s with a coincident 5xx rate increasing from 0.2% to 3.7% over the last 18 minutes. The customer is already on Dedicated capacity (reserved).

I've pulled the first traces and attached a short sampler (pinnacle_error_samples.log). Initial hypothesis: a KV cache eviction storm plus a sustained high-concurrency burst from an internal batch job at their side. Need exec attention because they've flagged SLA and legal has been looped.

Playbook next steps I recommend: 1) short exec bridge to coordinate messaging; 2) failover to fallback model variant (quantized) for serving while infra mitigates; 3) cross-check Dedicated pool headroom and autoscale logs.

Marcus
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-07-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Exec Bridge Notes & Immediate Action Items — Pinnacle escalation

Bridge happened 08:50–09:00 PT. Summary (short):
- Incident: p95 latency and 5xx spike in us-west-2, impacting /generate and /chat endpoints for customer Pinnacle Health.
- Impact: intermittent timeouts and degraded QPS; customer reported production errors visible in their UI.
- Root signals: large number of slightly-longer-than-usual KV cache misses; concurrent request burst traced to a mis-scheduled batch job at Pinnacle (see SRE note below).

Decisions / Actions agreed:
1) Immediate: failover traffic for Pinnacle to a lighter-quantized model variant hosted in us-west-2 to reduce per-token latency and reduce memory pressure (Karthik to execute).
2) Autoscale: Karthik to spin up two additional reserved nodes in the Dedicated pool for Pinnacle for 45 minutes as headroom while we monitor.
3) Customer comms: Vanessa to send a brief update to Dana (done).
4) Legal/procurement: Aditya to confirm contractual SLA boundaries and prepare a credit estimate if uptime breach is confirmed.
5) Postmortem plan: Marcus + Laura to own a combined technical + customer postmortem and a prioritized list of mitigations (prefetching, cache-priming, and burst-smoothing recommendations).

Open questions:
- Can we fully mitigate without cross-region routing? (Karthik: trying to avoid routing to eu/us-east due to data locality).
- Is the quantized variant meeting quality bar for Pinnacle's production prompts? (Laura: agreed to run a short A/B sample with key prompt set).

Next update 09:35 PT. I uploaded a mutual_action_plan-v2.docx and the first trace bundle to the Drive link in the thread.

-Priya
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Bridge Notes & Immediate Action Items — Pinnacle escalation

Status update — 09:22 PT:
- Spun two reserved nodes in Dedicated us-west-2 for Pinnacle (IDs: DED-PH-09A, DED-PH-09B). Live in ~2 minutes.
- Deployed quantized model variant (redwood-gptq-1-small) on the fallback pool and routed 35% of Pinnacle traffic to it. Early telemetry: p95 latency for routed traffic ~420ms vs 1.9s previously; 5xx for routed traffic ~0.2%.
- Memory pressure decreased by 18% on the primary instances.

Action items for next 20–40 minutes: continue gradual ramp of routed traffic to quantized variant up to 60% while Laura validates quality on a small prompt set. Marcus to monitor error traces and KV eviction metrics.

-Karthik
Head of Infra, Redwood Inference

Attachment: deployment_logs_09_22.txt (snippet)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Walsh <dana.walsh@pinnaclehealth.com>, SRE <sre@pinnaclehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident update: stabilization confirmed & next steps (Pinnacle)

Dana, team —

Short update from the executive coordination:
- Stabilization: After routing to the quantized variant and adding two reserved nodes, p95 latency for Pinnacle production has reduced from peak 1.9s to 360–500ms across the board. 5xx rate is back down to 0.25% and trending to baseline.
- Root cause: combination of a mis-scheduled internal batch at Pinnacle and a transient cache eviction storm in our Dedicated pool. A full technical postmortem will include timeline, mem/eviction analysis, and mitigation plan.
- Customer-facing commitments: a) we've scheduled a joint technical review tomorrow at 11:00 PT to walk traces and planned mitigations; b) Redwood will provide a preliminary credit estimate within 48 hours if SLA thresholds are breached per contract.

Attachments included: pinnacl_error_samples.log, mutual_action_plan-v2.docx (MAP with owners/timelines).

Thank you for working closely with us on this. Laura & Marcus will lead the postmortem; I'll coordinate the executive summary and credit estimate with Aditya.

-Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Escalations, Redwood Inference
